text:
elaine: Heads-up: docs PR #4825 has a mismatch for /v1/generate response. The examples show an "outputs" array but the runtime returns "choices". Also the Go snippet uses MaxNewTokens (camelCase) instead of the API field name max_new_tokens. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4825
cheng: Good catch. The runtime switched to "choices" last quarter; openapi still has "outputs" in samples. We should update the canonical examples and add a short migration note.
elaine: I can open a tiny PR to change the examples. Quick question — for backward compat do we want examples to show both fields or stick to the canonical "choices" and mention "outputs" as legacy?
noah: Prefer clarity: canonical examples should use "choices". Add a short migration callout that "outputs" is an alias for now and will be removed. Keep the example minimal.
samira: @samira can take the Go/TS snippet updates. Note: the Go client maps snake_case to struct fields (MaxNewTokens) but the request body in examples should show snake_case.
samira: On it. I'll update the Go snippet and add a one-line comment explaining the mapping.
elaine: Proposed curl + JSON example I'm about to push: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-7b", "input":"Summarize...", "max_new_tokens":128}'
``` And the response example change: ```json
{
  "id": "gen_123",
  "choices": [ { "text": "..." } ]
}
``` I'll also update openapi samples/openapi/generate.yaml to list "choices".
docs-bot: Auto-detected: docs PR #4825 touches samples/openapi/generate.yaml. CI: docs-lint reported schema mismatch errors on examples.
cheng: I'll add a quick runtime acceptance test to ensure we still accept "outputs" bodies for a deprecation window. Won't block the docs fix.
samira: Pushed branch samira/docs-gen-fix with updated snippets and an inline comment: // API expects 'max_new_tokens' in the JSON body. PTAL @elaine @cheng
elaine: :thumbsup: I'll merge the docs example changes once CI is green. Can we add a tiny docs pipeline check that validates code samples against the OpenAPI? Would reduce these mismatches.
cheng: Good idea — I'll add a smoke test to the docs pipeline that parses examples and checks field names tomorrow.
noah: Please also add a short line in the next release notes about the schema name standardization and the deprecation of "outputs".
elaine: Done — PR description updated with migration note and mapping snippet. Preview: https://deploy-preview-4825--redwood-docs.netlify.app/reference/generate
samira: :eyes: Reviewed and left one tiny wording nit. LGTM otherwise. I'll follow up with the SDK release note and a changelog entry.
